notes:
## Better
- The launcher fits small laptop screens (1366x768, big Windows text): the window and the coding window are never taller than the screen.
- Long tooltips wrap, right-click menus and lists are dark like the rest of the launcher, and version names and status texts end in "..." instead of being cut off.
- After sending a problem report or a message, the window shows Close (no more Sent and Done buttons).
- Problem reports leave out more: VINs in any form and the address of a remote car.
- Help improve names never sends a typed e-mail address or phone number.
- Uninstalling with "remove from E-Sys" also cleans your own E-Sys entries.
